text:
tanya: Heads-up everyone — rolling HorizonRT FastPath (rt-fast-* variants) + Smart Failover to GA for hosted API today. Additive endpoints and a routing header to control fallback. :tada:

devex: Quick note: new endpoints are /v1/realtime/stream and /v1/generate-rt. No breaking changes to existing realtime paths. Migration guide: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted/horizonrt-migrate

tanya: Default behavior: Smart Failover ON for new orgs. It swaps to compatible variants (region or quantized) when health/latency degrades. Per-route opt-out available in Console or via header x-rw-routing-policy: "no-fallback".

ops-bot: deploy 1861.12 initiated by tanya — canary 5% traffic us-west-2. Dashboard: https://deploy.redwood.ai/1861.12

eng-oncall: We'll watch canary for 72h. Alert thresholds: p95 +20% or error-rate >2x baseline. Tag eng-oncall on issues.

samir: Any pricing changes?

tanya: No pricing changes at launch. HorizonRT is tuned for lower latency streaming so throughput per GPU improves; we'll update pricing if needed later.

devex: Quick curl example for streaming:

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \ 
  -H "x-rw-routing-policy: prefer-low-latency" \ 
  -d '{"model":"horizonrt-fast-medium","input":"hello"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/stream
```

samir: I'll run smoke tests against the canary and file anything in the rollout board.

tanya: Thanks — product will post customer-facing notes after canary health check. Ping me for any urgent rollbacks. :rocket:
